OPEN CONSTRUCTION THROUGH THE CHEMICAL AND ENERGY GATE
2026-10-24. Owned initial operation is preserved unchanged in INITIAL_CONSTRUCTION.txt.
No sibling proposal or model-first prompt was read before this checkpoint.

Result

The proposed oxidation/energy-return route reaches a concrete construction and
a quantitative obstruction, not an enabling ammonia discovery. Actual selective
NOx/H2 power production is source-reported for an established alkaline nitrate
cell. It does not supply an attractive fresh air/water ammonia energy balance.
The initially preferable nitrite carrier has a measured positive-potential
reaction window, but an industrial-current full-cell power window and a closed,
concentrated air-to-nitrite carrier remain unacquired. Two chemical operations
have been derived and tested against primary evidence below. Plant advantage,
novelty and a new enabling material response are NOT_ESTABLISHED.

1. Close the alkali carrier without a fictitious acid source

Initial V0 used NO2-+H++3H2 -> NH3+2H2O. A concrete ion architecture is a
common alkaline electrolyte, which avoids an externally maintained pH split:

  Cathode: NO2-+5H2O+6e- -> NH3+7OH-
  Anode:   3H2+6OH- -> 6H2O+6e-
  Net:     KNO2+3H2 -> NH3+KOH+H2O.

The regenerated KOH can capture upstream nitrogen oxides:

  NO+NO2+2KOH -> 2KNO2+H2O.

Starting with N2+O2 ->2NO and then oxidizing half the NO gives the complete
carrier preparation N2+1.5O2+2KOH ->2KNO2+H2O. Combining this with two
reduction turnovers returns both potassium and hydroxide. Finally electrolyze
the required water to H2: the external net is N2+3H2O ->2NH3+1.5O2.
There is no stoichiometric salt consumption or free proton donor in this ideal
loop. There is also no extra energy benefit from counting its seven cathodic
protons/OH equivalents without the six opposing anode equivalents.

This is a REAL reaction specification but not a demonstrated capture cycle.
It requires an appropriate NO:NO2 ratio, efficient absorption, measured
nitrite/nitrate speciation, product stripping, and restored KOH composition.
Excess oxidation gives nitrate. Then KNO3+4H2 ->NH3+KOH+2H2O; the potassium
still closes, but the hydrogen requirement increases. For a nitrate fraction f
in the captured N, n_H2=3+f per NH3 at perfect selectivity. Carbonate, sulfate,
membrane/catalyst loss and purges cannot be silently charged to carrier makeup.

WHOLE ADVERSARIAL REVIEW OF THE MODEL-FIRST AMMONIA CONSTRUCTION
2026-10-24. Review after owned open-arm checkpoint was frozen.

Disposition

The specified Mo/Ru cycle is atom-balanced and exposes a useful, falsifiable
central chemistry problem. Its pressure-work identity and stationary ring
calculation check. A substantive repair is needed before its per-N transfer
can be assigned an elementary rate: three receiver hydrides cannot disappear
as 1.5 individual H2 molecules in one isolated two-molecule event. The known
Ru hydrogenolysis establishes real receiver states, but neither the required
Mo-to-Ru transfer nor quantitative carrier reset at common operating conditions
has been acquired. The strongest narrow result is an experimentally specified
acquisition target with a microscopic closure obstruction. New operation,
novelty, useful throughput and process advantage remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.

1. Inventory and the integer-hydrogen repair

A=MoL3 is formal Mo(III); AN=NMoL3 is Mo(VI), L=N(tBu)Ar anionic.
PNP=N(CH2CH2PtBu2)2 is an amido pincer; HPNP has an additional N-H.
BN=RuN(PNP), B3=RuH3(PNP), B5=RuH4(HPNP) are all formal Ru(IV).
B5 has FIVE variable H atoms, four hydrides and one pincer proton; B3 has
three hydrides. The primary author chapter assigns 4 RuH at -8.48 ppm and
1 NH at 4.54 ppm. Those hydrogens cannot be removed from the reset ledger.

The proposed equations balance macroscopically:
 T: AN+B3 -> A+BN+1.5H2.
 H: BN+4H2 -> B5+NH3.
 R: B5 -> B3+H2.
Their sum is AN+1.5H2 -> A+NH3; twice plus 2A+N2->2AN gives HB stoichiometry.
The Mo(VI)->Mo(III) reduction in T is supplied formally by oxidizing three
hydrides to H2. It is internal chemical redox, not three external electrons
or evidence of electrical work extraction.

However, T is a per-N thermodynamic reaction, not an isolated elementary
bimolecular molecular event. Its integer form is
 2AN+2B3 -> 2A+2BN+3H2.
An actual mechanism must pair turnovers or store/recombine the odd H on a
specified intermediate, ligand, surface or carrier. That inventory changes
the kinetic network and potentially the active receiver population. The
integer formula itself does not establish an elementary fourth-order event.
Likewise AN+B3 association can be bimolecular while its completion rate is
not a bare two-body N-transfer constant. A coarse reverse term involving
a_H2^1.5 cannot be silently promoted into one elem
